blocks.text: DAGUPAN CITY – The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) in the Ilocos Region distributed P16.5 million in projects to local governments and fisherfolk in various coastal towns of Pangasinan on Monday during the Dagupan leg of the Handog ng Pangulo program. BFAR Regional Director Remely Lachica led the distribution of 25-foot fiberglass-reinforced motorized fishing boats complete with accessories to fisherfolk from the Pangasinan towns of Anda and Infanta and Dagupan City, and a 30-foot boat to the local government of Bolinao.
